```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(bslib)
cars <- mtcars |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("model") |>
  mutate(
    transmission = if_else(am == 1, "Manual", "Automatic"),
    engine = paste(cyl, "cylinders"),
    efficiency_group = case_when(
      mpg >= 25 ~ "High",
      mpg >= 18 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Low"
    )
  )
summary_stats <- cars |>
  summarise(
    models = n(),
    avg_mpg = mean(mpg),
    avg_hp = mean(hp),
    manual_share = mean(transmission == "Manual")
  )
by_engine <- cars |>
  group_by(engine) |>
  summarise(
    models = n(),
    avg_mpg = mean(mpg),
    avg_hp = mean(hp),
    avg_weight = mean(wt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
